statement: A two-vertex meridian-and-tube presentation gives explicit substitutions for r, s, tau and every rho_j on pi_g, with all base-path inner ambiguities specified.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the proof specifies all choices and does not depend on the unsettled descriptive words.
notes: Surface relator and all finite and semidirect relations checked in the group, using an exact Dehn reducer, for genera 2 through 8; cellular proof applies to every g>=2.

statement: The tube stabilizer is C2^3 with explicitly conjugate affine annulus actions; theta_new=theta_old+pi t/2 identifies the free antipodal extension with the manuscript formula.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the proof specifies all choices and does not depend on the unsettled descriptive words.
notes: Eight maps, every involution/commutation relation, and the coordinate conjugacy computed symbolically over the rationals.

statement: One one-holed-torus subgroup per cut-system tube generates a proper subgroup for every choice of transversals: all generators preserve an explicit mod-two quadratic refinement, and a band-sum twist does not. Pairwise commutation, braid and free-subgroup relations are determined by geometric intersection.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the proof specifies all choices and does not depend on the unsettled descriptive words.
notes: No disjoint-strip assumption is used for the properness conclusion. Every mod-two transversal intersection matrix and vector is checked in genera 2,3,4; the displayed identity proves the general case.
